$comment: HAND-AUTHORED from v0211-hexadecimal-nullbin-round.xml (Rule 10, D-030). BinType=HexaDecimal - the schema's own spelling, with the capital D, which is the enum member and not a typo. Two fixed-width characters per cell, concatenated with no separator, on a 9x9 round wafer whose off-wafer cells carry NullBin=F0. F0 is a legal hex token that is NOT zero, so a reader that treated the null bin as 00 would read twenty corner cells as a real bin. Uppercase throughout: the tokens are compared as strings, never parsed to a number and re-formatted.
